plain: The bank is lending you $25,000.
legal: The Lender agrees to lend the Borrower the principal sum of $25,000.

plain: Interest is 6.5% a year.
legal: Interest shall accrue at the rate of 6.5% per annum.

plain: You'll repay the loan in 60 monthly payments.
legal: The Borrower shall repay the Loan in sixty (60) monthly installments.

plain: You can pay off the loan early without a penalty.
legal: The Borrower may prepay the Loan in whole or in part without penalty.

plain: If you miss 2 payments, the whole loan becomes due.
legal: If the Borrower fails to make two (2) consecutive payments, the entire outstanding balance shall become immediately due and payable.

plain: The car is security for the loan.
legal: The Loan shall be secured by the Vehicle.

plain: You can't sell the car until the loan is paid off.
legal: The Borrower shall not sell the Vehicle until the Loan has been repaid in full.

plain: Your parent is guaranteeing the loan.
legal: The Borrower's parent shall act as guarantor of the Loan.

plain: If you don't pay, the guarantor has to.
legal: If the Borrower fails to make any payment when due, the Guarantor shall make such payment.

plain: Keep the car insured for the whole loan period.
legal: The Borrower shall keep the Vehicle insured for the entire term of the Loan.

plain: We'll send you a statement every quarter.
legal: The Lender shall provide the Borrower with a quarterly statement.

plain: The interest rate may change with the central bank rate.
legal: The interest rate may be adjusted in line with changes in the central bank's base rate.

plain: We'll tell you 30 days before any rate change.
legal: The Lender shall notify the Borrower not less than thirty (30) days before any change in the interest rate.

plain: Late payments cost $35 each.
legal: A charge of $35 shall apply to each late payment.

plain: The overdraft limit is $1,000.
legal: The overdraft facility shall be subject to a limit of $1,000.

plain: The bank can lower your limit with notice.
legal: The Bank may reduce the overdraft limit upon giving notice.

plain: Savings accounts pay interest monthly.
legal: Interest on savings accounts shall be paid monthly.

plain: Withdrawals of more than $10,000 need 3 days' notice.
legal: Withdrawals exceeding $10,000 shall require three (3) days' notice.

plain: The fixed deposit can't be withdrawn for 12 months.
legal: The fixed deposit shall not be withdrawn for a period of twelve (12) months.

plain: Breaking the deposit early means you lose the interest.
legal: Early withdrawal of the deposit shall result in forfeiture of the accrued interest.

plain: Tell the bank right away if your card is lost or stolen.
legal: The Cardholder shall notify the Bank immediately upon the loss or theft of the card.

plain: You aren't liable for transactions after you report the card lost.
legal: The Cardholder shall not be liable for any transaction made after the card has been reported lost.

plain: The bank will never ask for your PIN.
legal: The Bank shall never request the Cardholder's PIN.

plain: The grant must be used only for the approved project.
legal: The Grant shall be used solely for the Approved Project.

plain: Unused grant money must be returned by December 31.
legal: Any unspent portion of the Grant shall be returned by December 31.

plain: You need to send a progress report every 6 months.
legal: The Grantee shall submit a progress report every six (6) months.

plain: Investments can go down as well as up.
legal: The value of investments may fall as well as rise.

plain: Past performance doesn't guarantee future results.
legal: Past performance is not a guarantee of future results.

plain: The fund charges a 1% annual management fee.
legal: The Fund shall charge an annual management fee of 1%.

plain: You can redeem your units on any business day.
legal: Units may be redeemed on any business day.

plain: The software is licensed, not sold.
legal: The Software is licensed, not sold.

plain: You can install it on one device.
legal: The Licensee may install the Software on one (1) device.

plain: Updates are free for the first year.
legal: Updates shall be provided free of charge during the first (1st) year.

plain: After that, updates cost $49 a year.
legal: Thereafter, updates shall be subject to an annual fee of $49.

plain: Don't share your license key.
legal: The Licensee shall not disclose the license key to any third party.

plain: We may collect anonymous usage data to improve the software.
legal: The Licensor may collect anonymized usage data for the purpose of improving the Software.

plain: You can turn off usage data collection in the settings.
legal: The Licensee may disable the collection of usage data through the settings.

plain: The software isn't meant for use in medical devices.
legal: The Software is not intended for use in medical devices.

plain: We'll keep supporting this version until December 2028.
legal: The Licensor shall continue to support this version until December 2028.

plain: We'll give you 6 months' notice before ending support.
legal: The Licensor shall give six (6) months' notice prior to the end of support.

plain: You must keep the software up to date to receive support.
legal: Support shall be provided only for the latest version of the Software.

plain: The cloud service stores data in 2 separate regions.
legal: The Cloud Service shall store data in two (2) separate geographic regions.

plain: Backups are taken daily and kept for 35 days.
legal: Backups shall be performed daily and retained for thirty-five (35) days.

plain: You can export your data at any time in CSV format.
legal: The Customer may export its data at any time in CSV format.

plain: We'll notify you of security incidents affecting your data without undue delay.
legal: The Provider shall notify the Customer without undue delay of any security incident affecting the Customer's data.

plain: Subcontractors that process your data will be listed on our website.
legal: Any subprocessor engaged to process Customer data shall be listed on the Provider's website.

plain: We'll tell you 30 days before adding a new subcontractor.
legal: The Provider shall give thirty (30) days' notice prior to engaging any new subprocessor.

plain: You can object to a new subcontractor within that time.
legal: The Customer may object to the appointment of any new subprocessor within such notice period.

plain: Admin accounts must use two-factor authentication.
legal: All administrator accounts shall be protected by two-factor authentication.

plain: Penetration tests are carried out once a year by an outside firm.
legal: Penetration testing shall be conducted annually by an independent third party.

plain: The source code will be kept with an escrow agent.
legal: The Source Code shall be deposited with an escrow agent.

plain: You get the code if we go out of business.
legal: The Source Code shall be released to the Licensee in the event that the Licensor ceases to carry on business.

plain: The app requires an internet connection.
legal: Use of the Application requires an internet connection.

plain: Some features are only available on the paid plan.
legal: Certain features shall be available only to subscribers of the paid plan.

plain: Generated outputs may contain errors, so check them before relying on them.
legal: Generated outputs may contain errors and shall be verified by the User before any reliance is placed upon them.

plain: You own the outputs you create with the tool.
legal: The User shall own all outputs generated by the User through the Tool.

plain: Don't use the tool to create harmful or illegal content.
legal: The User shall not use the Tool to generate any harmful or unlawful content.

plain: We may review flagged content to enforce our policies.
legal: The Provider may review flagged content for the purpose of enforcing its policies.

plain: The device must be returned at the end of the lease in working condition.
legal: Upon expiry of the lease, the Device shall be returned in good working condition.

plain: Lost devices are charged at $350 each.
legal: Lost devices shall be charged at $350 per unit.
